item.title: A Look Inside LSU Club Baseball - Reveille
item.description: Most people in the Baton Rouge area already have heard of the National Champion LSU Baseball team at Alex Box, but you can find similar action at Port Allen High School where the LSU Club Baseball team competes.LSU Students ranging from freshman all the way through seniors all come together to compete for the Tigers.

item.title: This LSU women's basketball freshman is carving a role of her own
item.description: Bella Hines is a player that everyone needs on their team. Someone willing to sacrifice their scoring for the greater good of her team.

item.title: LSU Lab Show 'Two Sisters and a Piano' portrays love amid turmoil - Reveille
item.description: LSU's upcoming Lab Show, "Two Sisters and a Piano," follows the sisters as they hold onto each other in the face of political turmoil.

item.title: How LSU baseball's offensive struggles have caused losses - Reveille
item.description: Timely hitting is not where it should be for LSU baseball, and it’s starting to cost games. LSU just can’t string it all together.
